structure.unit: Boundary Adjustments and Changes of Status of Counties, Cities and Towns
Consolidation of Like Units of Local Government

law.text: At the session of the General Assembly that follows the elections provided for in either § 15.2-3508 or § 15.2-3509, the governing body of the resulting consolidated county, city or town shall request its delegate or senator in the General Assembly to introduce a bill to repeal all obsolete charters of the local governments that have been consolidated.
